verdicts.reason: Authorized dealer and integrator of Graco dispensing equipment, providing turnkey industrial solutions without manufacturing its own hot melt equipment.
Distributes industrial hot melt systems, parts, and maintenance services for third-party brands like Nordson, Robatech, and Meler.
DROP because they manufacture their own products (hot melt sticks and adhesive spots), violating the criteria.
Distributor and turnkey partner for ITW Dynatec hot melt equipment without manufacturing its own lines.
Stocking distributor supplying hot melt equipment made by others, including Power Adhesives (TEC), Reka, and 3M.
Distributor of packaging tools and glues including the VenBond line of hot melt glue guns manufactured for them, alongside third-party brands.
